verification: Every status below was read from src/index.ts (312 lines) and public/index.html (821 lines). Line references are exact.

statusVocabulary.implemented: Backend route exists AND frontend calls it AND UI renders it
statusVocabulary.partial: Works but with a known correctness or UX gap
statusVocabulary.stub: Code path exists but is unreachable, dead, or non-functional
statusVocabulary.planned: Referenced in comments/placeholder text only; no code

features.name: Create task
features.notes: Title validated non-empty server-side. Returns 201 with full row.

features.name: List tasks with filters
features.frontend: fetchTodos() builds query string from filter state
features.notes: Sorted by is_pinned DESC, due_date ASC, created_at DESC. Parameterised SQL throughout.

features.name: Update task (partial)
gaps: No general-purpose edit UI - only 3 of the 8 supported fields are reachable from the frontend
features.notes: Dynamic SET clause built from present keys only; column names are hardcoded, so no injection.

features.name: Delete task
gaps: Returns {success:true} even when no row matched - client cannot distinguish delete of missing item
No confirmation dialog before destructive delete
features.notes: Fix: return 404 when changes === 0.

features.name: Toggle complete + completed_at tracking
features.backend: PATCH sets completed_at on rising edge, NULLs on falling edge
features.notes: Edge detection via comparison against existing.completed. Correct.

features.name: Pin task to top
features.backend: PATCH is_pinned; ORDER BY is_pinned DESC

features.name: Priority levels (urgent/high/medium/low)
gaps: Priority is free-text in POST/PATCH - no server-side enum validation, so an invalid value is storable and renders as 'Low'
features.notes: 4 levels rendered with distinct colour badges.

features.name: Due dates
features.backend: due_date column, due_date ASC ordering, dueToday stat
features.frontend: newDueDate input, due badge display, client-side 'today' filter
gaps: 'today' filter runs client-side after fetching ALL todos - does not scale, and disagrees with the server-side dueToday count
No overdue indication; a past-due task looks identical to a future one
due_date stored as TEXT with no format validation

features.name: Tags on tasks
features.frontend: newTagsStr comma-split, tag badges on card
gaps: Tags stored as a JSON string in a TEXT column - not normalised, not indexable, cannot be queried relationally
features.notes: Normalised lower-cased on create.

features.name: Filter by tag
features.backend: tag query param READ at src/index.ts:16 but NEVER added to the SQL query
features.evidence: src/index.ts:16 (declared), absent from query builder lines 19-43
gaps: CRITICAL: accepting ?tag=x silently returns unfiltered results - the API lies to its caller
No frontend surface at all
features.notes: Either implement in the query builder or remove the param read. Silently ignoring it is the worst option.

features.name: Lists / projects
gaps: No rename or edit of an existing list (create + delete only)
No reordering despite sort_order column existing
id generated via slug + 4 random chars - collision-prone and not user-controllable

features.name: Delete list reassigns its tasks
features.backend: UPDATE todos SET list_id='inbox' WHERE list_id=:id
gaps: Guard checks id==='default' but no list with id 'default' is ever created - the check for 'inbox' is the only one that can ever fire
features.notes: Prevents orphaned tasks. Good instinct.

features.name: Search title + description
features.backend: GET ?search= LIKE '%term%' on title OR description
gaps: LIKE wildcards (% and _) in user input are NOT escaped - a search for '100%' matches everything containing '100'
No debounce - fires a request per keystroke
No index; full table scan per keystroke
features.notes: Parameterised so no SQL injection, but wildcard semantics are unescaped.

features.name: Stats & analytics
gaps: Six separate COUNT(*) scans of the whole table on every stats fetch
No time-series/history - only an instantaneous snapshot
features.notes: total, completed, active, highPriority, dueToday, pomodoros.

features.name: Pomodoro timer
gaps: Timer state is NOT persisted - refresh or tab close loses the running session entirely
Uses alert() for completion - blocks the main thread and looks unfinished
Not tied to visibility; keeps ticking in a backgrounded tab with no notification
Work/break lengths hardcoded at 25/5 with no configuration
features.notes: Counts down, auto-switches to alert on zero, increments pomodoro_count on work completion.

features.name: Pomodoro count per task
gaps: Read-modify-write from the client ((todo.pomodoro_count||0)+1) - two concurrent timers silently lose an increment
features.notes: Should be a server-side atomic increment.

features.name: Estimated pomodoros
features.frontend: newPomodoros state declared (line 78) but NO input field renders it
features.evidence: src/index.ts:67, 86, 254; public/index.html:78 (state) - absent from the form at lines 658-750
gaps: UI control does not exist - value is always the default 1
Column exists and is written on every create, carrying dead data
features.notes: Add the form field or drop the column.

features.name: View tabs (All / Today / Active / Completed)
features.frontend: sidebar Overview buttons with live counts
features.notes: Counts sourced from /api/stats, not from the filtered fetch.

features.name: 'Upcoming' view
features.evidence: public/index.html:66 (state comment), 497 (title ternary) - no setActiveTab('upcoming') call exists anywhere
gaps: Header ternary renders a title for a view the user can never reach
features.notes: Dead code path.

features.name: Dark mode
gaps: Preference NOT persisted - resets to light on every reload
Does not read prefers-color-scheme, so system-dark users get a light flash
features.notes: Tailwind darkMode:'class' configured correctly.

features.name: Create list with colour
gaps: icon param accepted server-side, never selectable or rendered

features.name: Seeded demo data
features.backend: seedDefaults() - 4 lists, 4 tasks on first run
gaps: No opt-out; every new deployment is polluted with 4 fake tasks and 3 fake lists
Runs in the constructor - re-checked per DO instantiation
features.notes: Acceptable for demo, disqualifying for beta testers who want a clean slate.

features.name: Empty states
features.frontend: No tasks found card with CTA
features.notes: Good UX touch - has icon, copy, and a call to action.

features.name: Responsive layout
features.evidence: public/index.html:307 (search hidden sm:block), 350 (sidebar hidden lg:flex), 319 (timer hidden md:flex)
gaps: CRITICAL: sidebar is hidden below lg with NO drawer, menu button, or alternative nav - on mobile you cannot switch lists or views at all
Menu icon is imported (line 58) but never rendered - the affordance was intended and never built
features.notes: Effectively desktop-only despite responsive styling.

features.name: Error handling / user feedback
features.frontend: every catch block only calls console.error
gaps: CRITICAL: a failed request leaves the UI silently stale - no toast, no retry, no visible failure
Server error responses (400/404) are never surfaced to the user
features.notes: The single biggest beta blocker after auth.

features.name: ⌘K keyboard shortcut
features.frontend: advertised in search placeholder text only
features.evidence: public/index.html:311 (placeholder string) - no keydown listener exists
gaps: UI promises a shortcut that does not exist
features.notes: Either wire a keydown handler or remove the hint.

features.name: Authentication / access control
features.backend: none - no auth, no tokens, no session
features.evidence: grep for auth|bearer|token|session|cookie across repo returns only the word 'session' in an alert() string
gaps: BLOCKER: any holder of the URL has full read/write access to all data
features.notes: Beta cannot ship without this unless access is gated at the Cloudflare layer.

features.name: Data export
gaps: Testers have no way to extract their data; user-owned-data expectation unmet for beta
features.notes: A single GET /api/export returning JSON would suffice.

features.name: Automated tests
features.evidence: glob for *test*/*spec* across repo returns no files
gaps: BLOCKER: no regression safety net; every change is unverified
features.notes: vitest + Workers pool is the platform-native choice.

features.name: Pagination / bounded reads
features.backend: GET /api/todos performs SELECT * with no LIMIT or cursor
features.frontend: fetchTodos() fetches the entire filtered set in one request
features.evidence: src/index.ts:19 (SELECT * FROM todos), 45 (exec with no LIMIT); public/index.html:120-143 (no paging state)
gaps: BLOCKER-for-GA: unbounded SELECT grows with dataset size. Fine at 50 rows, a timeout at 50,000.
No LIMIT, no OFFSET, no cursor, no infinite-scroll trigger
Client holds the entire task list in one useState array
features.notes: Tracked separately from FEAT-002 because listing works correctly at small scale - the gap only appears under load, which makes it easy to miss.

features.name: CI/CD pipeline
gaps: No typecheck, no test gate, no automated deploy

summary.assessment: The product is beta-shaped; the engineering is alpha. 20 of 31 features are usable today, but 4 are phantoms that appear to work and do not, which is worse than absent.
